info.title: PaperGo API
info.description: One organization per SQLite deployment. Immutable schema/content revisions, SharePoint-style exclusive permission scopes, head/published projections, rich typed fields, reusable templates, saved queries, personal/shared smart folders with cross-collection navigation and classification, taxonomy, and typed relationships. Libraries with webdav_enabled are also served over WebDAV (RFC 4918 class 1 and 2) at /webdav/{libraryID}/, outside this contract; In OIDC/development deployments, WebDAV accepts provider bearer tokens or HTTP Basic with a WebDAV credential password. In trusted proxy mode, browsers and WebDAV clients authenticate with proxy Basic credentials over HTTPS, WebDAV credential endpoints are unavailable, and personal and integration access tokens authenticate directly. Workflows (triggers, a condition and a flow of activities, with built-in workflows people can turn on, configure or copy) react to committed item changes, schedules and manual starts; runs are durable and are listed under each workspace. Organization groups support nested membership; persisted roles grant module scopes independently of resource ACLs. Verified subjects enroll with the Member role on first authentication. Local deployments authenticate REST requests with HTTP Basic credentials or the session cookie issued by POST /auth/login; profiles are locally managed. ADMIN_SUBJECT provisions the first administrator once; local authentication defaults to admin, and development defaults to DEV_SUBJECT.

delete.description: Deletes an item or empty folder with write access and the current If-Match. For a folder, recursive=true deletes the folder and all live descendants atomically, requiring write access to every descendant. Without recursive=true, any live child, including a hidden item or nested folder, returns 409 with code folder_not_empty. Deleted children do not prevent ordinary deletion. Permission failures and stale versions leave the entire tree unchanged. Workspace and collection deletion require manage access and list.manage and remove the entire live resource tree independently of recursive; collection managers may delete the entire collection regardless of descendant ACLs. Tombstones, revisions and audit history are retained. Read projections and live relationships are removed, and each deleted item emits item.deleted. Workflows bound to a deleted workspace or collection are disabled and deleted.

put.description: Break, copy or reset inheritance using typed user, group and workspace role principals. Copied group grants retain group IDs and resolve current nested memberships. Copying workspace inheritance retains dynamic visitor/member/owner role principals. Workspace owners and workspace.manage holders retain control. A permission change that removes the caller's manage access rolls back. list.manage and resource manage access are required. Required module scopes: list.manage. Resource ACLs and any additional use-case checks also apply. ACL changes deliver permissions.changed (action=replace) to the resource and every item and folder that inherits from it, with previous_scope_id and current_scope_id; the root event, with previous/current permission snapshots (inherit, grants, scope_id, effective_grants), commits with the write and audit, and the dispatcher delivers it in batches. Unchanged ACLs raise no event.

put.description: Checks the library duplicate policy in the same transaction as the new file revision. Warn returns duplicates; block returns 409 duplicate_file and stores no revision. Self, deleted items, historical files and inaccessible content do not count. Requires list.write and document.write and item write access with current If-Match. Identical bytes share storage across items and workspaces; file-version metadata and access remain independent. Unreferenced completed objects are periodically collected after a one-hour grace period. Accepts only PDF, TIFF, JPEG, PNG and WebP detected from file signatures; filenames and declared MIME types do not determine stored content_type. Unsupported bytes return 415 without item/revision changes. Size limits apply while streaming.

get.description: Ordinary readers can download only the current published blob, including with blob_id. Draft readers default to head and may request retained historical blobs. Required module scopes: list.read and document.read. Resource ACLs and any additional use-case checks also apply.

Retained files of a library item, newest first. Draft readers see every version; ordinary readers see only the published file. `is_current` marks the file of the caller's visible revision, `created_by` who uploaded or restored that version, and `availability` whether the bytes are still stored. A reclaimed version keeps its id, version, filename, content type, size and checksum; downloading or restoring it reports that the content is unavailable. Restore a version that still has its bytes with POST /v1/items/{id}/content/versions/{number}/restore. Required module scopes: list.read, document.read. Resource ACLs and any additional use-case checks also apply.
